test_register_config_iterator: test that register_config_iterator adds a ConfigIterator subclass to config_iterator_map and rejects duplicates
test_register_data_generator: test that register_data_generator adds a DataGenerator subclass to data_generator_map and rejects duplicates
test_register_operator: test that register_operator adds an OperatorInterface subclass to op_map and rejects duplicate registrations
test_register_operators: test that register_operators bulk-registers multiple operators and raises ValueError when any name already exists
run_test_register_suite: run the TestRegister unittest suite to validate all registration functions for config iterators, data generators, and operators
